    StartersCairo datesMedjool dates stuffed with goat's cheese and almond, wrapped in prosciutto, honeyHow to make it12 medjool dates100g goat's cheese12 almonds, toasted100g prosciutto2 tbsp honeySplit the dates and stuff each with goat's cheese and an almond.Wrap each in a piece of prosciutto.Bake at 200°C for 8 minutes and drizzle with honey.Cairo market falafelCrisp falafel made from raw chickpeas, with lemon tahini sauceHow to make it250g dried chickpeas1 brown onion2 garlic cloves1/2 bunch parsley1/2 bunch coriander1 tsp ground cumin2 L vegetable oil, for frying4 tbsp tahini1 lemon, juicedsalt, to tasteSoak the chickpeas in cold water overnight, then drain well.Blitz the raw chickpeas with the onion, garlic, parsley, coriander, cumin and salt.Shape into balls and flatten slightly.Fry in the vegetable oil at 175°C until deep brown.Thin the tahini with lemon juice and water for the sauce.Golden idol gruyère cheese puffsThe golden idol swapped for a bag of sandHow to make itAs written, serves 4Golden choux puffs loaded with gruyère and cayenne, baked until hollow and crisp, served warm in a hessian sack with a smoky tomato dip.Boil 125ml water with 50g butter, beat in 75g plain flour and stir over the heat for 1 minute.Cool slightly, beat in 2 eggs one at a time, then 80g grated gruyère and a pinch of cayenne.Pipe 20 small rounds, brush with egg and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until puffed and golden.Serve warm with tomato chutney mixed with smoked paprika.Chilli fried potatoes with yak cheeseHot from the fire. the rice, lentils and macaroni separately.Simmer the tomatoes with the garlic, cumin and chilli into a sauce.Fry the onions in oil until crisp.Layer rice, lentils and macaroni, then top with the sauce, chickpeas and onions.The Raven bar pork momoMarion's bar in Nepal, the RavenHow to make itAs written, serves 4Juicy pork and coriander dumplings with ginger and spring onion, steamed until tender, with a fiery charred tomato and chilli achar.Mix 500g pork mince with 2 tsp grated ginger, 2 garlic cloves, 3 spring onions, a handful of chopped coriander, 1 tbsp soy and salt.Fill 30 round dumpling wrappers, gather and pleat closed.Steam on oiled baking paper for 10 minutes.Char 3 tomatoes and 2 red chillies in a dry pan, then blitz with a garlic clove, 1 tsp cumin, lemon juice and salt
